verifier_reason: test_outputs.py::test_clean_html_unchanged: The test failed in the call phase due to an assertion error

items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Constants are well named and there are some section comments ("6F. <style>"). But business logic uses cryptic short names such as `k`, `a`, `r`, `nc`, `vn`, `tl` and `m`. There's also odd casing in `is_safe_Image_data_uri`, and long parsing branches have few comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: One new file of about 1217 lines. `sanitize_pass` runs about 320 lines (L815-L1135), well past the 100-line cap. The iframe/svg/style branches repeat the same `had_bad_attrs`/`close_info` logic, and there is a second bs4 fallback pipeline on top of the custom tokenizer.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: File handling uses `with` and an explicit encoding. However, `normalize_for_scheme` has `except Exception: break`, there are magic loop counts (`range(5)`, `range(10)`, `range(3)`), and `main` exits with status 1 and no usage message.

items.name: Obfuscated vectors neutralised
items.evidence: General rules cover the listed vectors: on* names are normalised, schemes are decoded from entities, %-encoding, comments and control characters, srcdoc/xlink:href/formaction are handled, script/object/embed/base/meta-refresh are denied, svg/math/iframe are handled, and null bytes are stripped.

items.name: Minimal edits on dirty documents
items.name_zh: 含恶意内容的文档仅做最小修改
items.evidence: Offset-based reconstruction keeps benign markup byte-for-byte. But test_clean_html_unchanged failed, so it changes benign content: over-broad rules (e.g. link rel=preload/prefetch, meta content url=) and the bs4 re-serialisation fallback can alter output.
